observed_behavior: SC 1.4.10 requires presentation without loss of information/functionality and unnecessary two-dimensional scrolling at 320 CSS px width for vertical-scrolling content or 256 CSS px height for horizontal-scrolling content, except intrinsically two-dimensional parts.
context: W04 six-family controlled responsive-acquisition run; source-bounded observation, not design recommendation
limitations: 320 CSS px is a test equivalent, not a universal design breakpoint; 2D content exceptions matter.
notes: SOURCE INSPECTED; no browser, device or accessibility conformance test conducted
